name: Simulator dispatch outcome
purpose: The Simulator's ACCEPTED or REJECTED answer to one dispatch intake, with a closed reason code. ACCEPTED means queued as a kernel event, not executed.
authority_level: Simulation operational fact about one intake; not Core canonical state and not an effect-verification result
security_classification: Internal simulation dispatch metadata; SIMULATION provenance; no credentials and no evaluator-only (Oracle) field

semantics.errors: Closed reason codes: MALFORMED, UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, ORACLE_FIELD_REJECTED, WRONG_WORLD, DUPLICATE_CONFLICT, STALE_REVISION, DECISION_TIME_MISMATCH, UNKNOWN_LOT, LOT_REVISION_MISMATCH, LOT_HELD, LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED, WRONG_ROUTE_STEP, UNKNOWN_MACHINE, MACHINE_INELIGIBLE, MACHINE_UNAVAILABLE, CORE_AUTHORIZATION_MISSING, CORE_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID. Messages never repeat input values.
semantics.acceptance: HTTP-style acceptance is not execution: ACCEPTED is queued, execution is a later kernel event and may still be rejected on revalidation (DISPATCH_START_REJECTED).
semantics.idempotency: The same dispatch_id and identical intake bytes return the stored outcome.
